report_name: Ukraine's HUR Claims Cyber and Drone Strikes on Russian Retailer Wildberries

threat_actors.name: Ukraine's Main Intelligence Directorate (HUR)
threat_actors.description: Ukraine's Main Intelligence Directorate (HUR), a state military intelligence agency, which claimed responsibility for a hybrid cyber and physical attack against the Russian e-commerce platform Wildberries.

threat_actors.name: Cyber Corps
threat_actors.description: A cyber warfare community affiliated with and directed by Ukraine's HUR, which conducted the cyberattack against Wildberries' digital infrastructure on August 10-11, 2026.

attack_patterns.name: Endpoint Denial of Service
attack_patterns.description: The cyberattack disrupted Wildberries' payment systems, a form of endpoint denial of service that directly impacted the company's revenue and customer service by targeting payment software.

attack_patterns.name: Network Denial of Service
attack_patterns.description: The cyberattack targeted Wildberries' service channels, overwhelming them with traffic to create a customer service crisis, consistent with network denial of service.

identities.name: Wildberries
identities.description: Russia's largest online retailer and e-commerce platform, targeted by a hybrid cyber and physical attack from Ukraine's HUR due to its alleged support for the Russian war effort.

indicators.name: Application-Layer Denial of Service on Payment Gateway
indicators.pattern:
title: Application-Layer Denial of Service on Payment Gateway
id: 2b1a9c8d-4e5f-4a3b-8c7d-6e5f4a3b2c1d
status: experimental
description: Detects a high rate of server-side errors (HTTP 5xx) on common payment gateway API endpoints, which can indicate an application-layer Denial of Service attack as described in the Wildberries incident.
references:
  - https://kyivindependent.com/ukraines-hur-claims-cyberattack-on-wildberries-russian-sellers-complain-of-more-disruption/
author: cyber.netsecops.io
date: 2026-08-16
tags:
  - attack.t1499
  - attack.impact
level: medium
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    sc-status: 500
    cs-uri-stem|contains:
      - '/api/payment'
      - '/checkout'
      - '/process_transaction'
  condition: selection
indicators.description: Detects a high rate of server-side errors (HTTP 5xx) on common payment gateway API endpoints, which can indicate an application-layer Denial of Service attack.

relationships.source_name: Application-Layer Denial of Service on Payment Gateway
